senses.definition: vb. shoot (cf. II. רָבַב, I. רָמָה);—only
Pt. רֹבֶה קַשָּׁ֑ת Gn 21:20 < רֹבֵה קָ֑שֶׁת, Kn Di al., but read prob. רֹמֵה ק׳ Ol Ball, one shooting the bow.
